object: bounded economic specification and deterministic reference model
question: Which declared improvements become agreements and executed changes, with what distribution, complete incurred cost and continuity under material change?
evidence_ceiling: Stage A support only; no formal DDS acceptance, no native ACC or UC21 execution

units.benefits_costs_transfers: one fictitious common monetary numeraire; transferable quasilinear utility in this toy only
units.time: integer logical ticks, not measured latency

costs.rule: preparation once, review every step including failed or blocked steps, transition cost only on effect; all entries unique and additive in this toy

transfer_rule: zero sum; per-actor debit limits; each transition includes its review fee in Marketing acceptance; preparation is explicitly commissioned and recorded separately, never an unnoticed external cost
negative_control: stale_reference; deliberately incomplete, excluded from primary superiority comparisons
fairness: same current admissible observations, grant, proposals, transfer options, review cost, preparation and general adaptation rules; no future information or retrospective policy patches
qualified_record_scope: toy record of a qualified decision; not an implementation of canonical EA, ACC, ABCD or MSCA
observation_rule: the simulator prepares the visible snapshot; policies receive only that snapshot and logical time, never the hidden actual state or manual oracle
effect_rule: technical executor checks current grant, expiry and scope; it does not automatically discover semantic obsolescence. Actual effects are adjudicated independently for current purpose, freeze, rights, service, version and actor balances

unresolved_cause_rule.after_budget: CAUSE_UNRESOLVED; do not invent a new dimension or alter the frozen model

primary_results: actual effects with currently legitimate basis
outcome_rule: record actual scenario PASS/FAIL/HOLD separately from whether the implementation matches the manual expected trace. A reproduced known failure remains scenario FAIL
exclusions: measured human welfare or skill loss
